goal: fw status enumerates every newly-recorded stopped or stranded unit with its stop reason -- the new per-run park kinds (held-out-gate, protected-paths, push-failed, submit-error) and the new per-task stop-event kinds (dangling-prerequisite, no-op-cycle, prepare-skip, source-truncation, zero-grader-drop) -- in both the text and the --json rendering, extending the existing stranded: surface rather than adding a separate view.

graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-orchestrator/ && uv run pyright packages/flywheel-orchestrator/
graders.name: lint-typecheck

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- _cmd_status (~1353-1480) already renders the stranded: line from the per-run LandingParked via _landing_park_for_run (~1335-1350); extend it to (a) recognize the new per-run park_kind values and (b) also read the new per-task stop-event records from the orchestrator-events ledger and enumerate those stopped units, in both the text path and the --json path (the entry['stranded'] / follow-up-line conventions)

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- the per-task stop-event read API (list_task_events / equivalent) added by the prerequisite task is the source the status reader queries for pre-run stops
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- the LandingParked.park_kind vocabulary the reader must recognize
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/ -- the status tests selected by -k status; keep them green and add assertions that each new stop kind appears (text and --json) with its reason
references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py:1474 -- the existing stranded: follow-up line is the rendering convention to mirror for the new kinds (omit-when-absent, reason after a dash)
constraints: Read both record surfaces (the per-run domain-event LandingParked AND the per-task orchestrator-events stop kinds) and union them into the status output; a unit stopped by ANY of the nine kinds must appear with its reason in both text and --json.
Extend the existing stranded: surface and its omit-when-absent convention rather than inventing a new top-level view or CLI verb.
Per-unit reason, not just a count: each enumerated unit carries its stop kind and detail so the operator can act without cross-referencing logs.
Do NOT change which units are stopped or how -- the status command is read-only over the records the prerequisite tasks emit (D-2).
This task depends on the exact park_kind and stop-event-kind spellings fixed by the two prerequisite tasks; use those shared spellings verbatim.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT add a re-drive, retry, or queue-drain action to status -- enumeration only (re-driving is a later phase).
Do NOT emit any new records here -- the producers are the prerequisite tasks; status only reads.
Do NOT change the existing stranded:/awaiting_on:/blocked_on: rendering for cases already covered.
Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion under packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/.
edge_cases: A store holding one of each new record kind: status text and --json each list every stopped/stranded unit with its reason; a kind that renders in text but is missing from --json (or vice versa) must fail.
A unit with NO stop record renders exactly as today (no stranded line) -- a spurious stranded line on a healthy unit must fail.
A recurring per-task stop (e.g. three prepare-skips) surfaces the unit as stopped with its reason -- status must not crash on multiple records for one task.
